lines.text:
Memes, jokes, and stubborn belief.
That's how Bitcoin is turning back into money.

There will never be enough Bitcoin for 8 billion people.
But there will always be enough sats.
Bitcoin's price moves every day. The 21 million supply cap never does.
Most skeptics don't change their mind about Bitcoin. They just stop mentioning it.
No tokens, no roadmap votes, no restarts. Just blocks, every ten minutes.
